tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 17 - no invented times, no false booking claims. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - measured live on v112 minutes ago, the most severe patient-trust defect yet: with real slots of 10:30 am and 10:45 am on Friday 08/28, the patient typed 'Lets do 1040'. The bot replied 'I have Friday 08/28/2026 10:40 am at MK2 Optical. Reply 1 to take it' - a time that DOES NOT EXIST (the practice grid is strict 15-minute increments: :00 :15 :30 :45). The patient said 'I will take it' and the bot replied 'Great, I have got you down for Friday 08/28/2026 at 10:40 am. We will see you then!' - a FALSE BOOKING CONFIRMATION: no booking webhook ever fired (book_success null, new_appt_id null, conversation ended on n_goal_ask, and the practice system shows zero appointments). So the patient believes they have an appointment that does not exist. SOURCES (copy into CWD, then edit): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD23/gl-round16-fix/ (round-16 draft = v112), validator (assertions 1-16), build scripts, frozen-extractors.json. THE FIX: (1) NO-BOOKING-CLAIM: add to the prompt of EVERY patient-facing wait node - n_goal_ask, n_goal_response, n_mixed_intent, n_gate_1, n_gate_2, n_post_booking, n_date_conflict, n_date_conflict_retry - a rule block starting with the exact marker 'NO-BOOKING-CLAIM:' stating: you have NOT booked anything and must never say or imply an appointment is booked, held, confirmed, reserved, set, or that we will see them then; only the system's own confirmation message after a completed booking may say that; if the patient believes they are booked and you have not confirmed a booking, tell them plainly that nothing is booked yet and continue. n_post_booking is the ONE exception in tone: it may state that their existing appointment stands (it is only reachable after a real booking), so its NO-BOOKING-CLAIM block says instead: never claim any NEW or CHANGED booking; changes go to the office. (2) TIME-GRID: add to the n_goal_response prompt a rule block starting with the exact marker 'TIME-GRID:' stating: appointment times exist only at :00, :15, :30 and :45; you may state ONLY the literal rendered slot values ({{slot_1_day_name}} {{slot_1_start}} / {{slot_2_day_name}} {{slot_2_start}}); if the patient names any other time - including a typo or an off-grid minute like 10:40 - say that time is not available and re-state the real slot values verbatim, then ask which they want. Keep the existing OFFER-INTEGRITY and BOOKING-INTEGRITY blocks intact. n_goal_response prompt may grow to at most 4,600 characters. (3) n_goal_ask must never state a clock time at all: keep it free of slot templates and add that instruction to its NO-BOOKING-CLAIM block. (4) CONFIRM CONTAINMENT: verify (and fix if needed) that n_confirm_1 and n_confirm_2 are reachable ONLY from their matching n_book_N (or the matching n_reconcile_N recovery path) - no other node may route into a confirm node. (5) Everything else from rounds 6-16 unchanged. (6) VALIDATOR: add ASSERTION 17 keeping 1-16 intact: every listed wait node prompt contains NO-BOOKING-CLAIM; n_goal_response contains TIME-GRID and still contains OFFER-INTEGRITY; n_goal_ask has no slot templates; each confirm node's inbound sources are only its book/reconcile pair. Structured FAIL citing 'assertion 17'; must PASS your draft and FAIL the untouched round-16 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD23/gl-round16-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json citing assertion 17. (7) build_goalloop.py regenerates deterministically; fixture-conformant.json updated. (8) DEBUG.md: the live evidence quoted, both defects, the changes, regeneration command; mention extract/prompt/compress context as before.
tasks.verified: Every patient-facing node is barred from claiming a booking it did not make, off-grid times are refused with the real slots restated verbatim, the pre-offer node cannot speak a time at all, and confirmations are reachable only from a completed booking - proven by the seventeen-assertion validator, rejection of the v112 draft, and the independent structural check.
